turn.text:
**First draft**

Hi, the heater has been broken since Monday. Could you please arrange a repair and let me know when someone can come by? Thank you.

**Firmer version to send**

Hi, the heater has been broken since Monday and needs to be repaired promptly. Please confirm when a repair person will come by. Thank you.

I can’t send it to your landlord, but I can put the firmer version in a note for you to share.
